notes: A screener predicate could always compute roeMedian5y * (1 - payoutRatio). It just could not KEEP it. run_screen's derive: has the right substrate and the wrong scope — one screen — so the same formula was retyped per screen and drifted; define_indicator's ci_<name> has the right scope and the wrong substrate, a series over price bars, which a fundamental derivation is not. A custom field is derive promoted to global scope, which is why it reuses server/expr.js — the DSL where and derive already parse — rather than inventing a third one. Define once as cf_<name>; it appears in list_screen_fiel
